column1: # Keyboard keys of the lists a click opens whose lines the game server sends (owner 2026-10-18: "we should probably
# cashe this instead of doing it at runtime ... figure it out via the cashe or wiki, then by myself if needed").
# option <tab> target <tab> order <tab> confirmed <tab> source. One row per list; the Data Tool's export gives each
# choice of that click the key of its place in the order ("1".."9", then "A".."Z", as client script 218 numbers a
# list), only when "confirmed" is yes. order: "sub-menu" = the item's right-click sub-menu of that option in the cache
# (every charge must give the same list); "spirit trees" = the spirit trees' "Last-destination" texts by varbit 20252.
# "listed: a; b; c" = the lines written here (a list the game server sends that the cache lacks), from a picture of it.
# "no" = not used: the owner answered the player picks the place from the right-click sub-menu, never this list.
